row_semantics: Exactly one row for every raw test S1; ID preserved verbatim; only existing test S2/S3 targets; lists comma-separated without spaces or duplicates; no-match list is an empty second field after an explicit tab.
candidate_definition: Final post-pruning set passed to the matching model for scoring, including candidates below the decision threshold.
matching_definition: All scored candidates at or above the frozen global threshold 0.61; zero and multiple matches allowed; each matching list is a subset of its candidate list.
documentation: Complete the methodology template with approach, blocking, model, validation and reproduction details.
model_license_rule: Final model MIT or Apache 2.0, at most 8 billion parameters.
fair_play: No external identity data, lookup API, geocoding service, or test labels.
